Deepak Kumar Singal 

Mobile:  

Email:  

 

Seeking assignments in Document control profile with BOM and ECN Management for 

Manufacturing or Repair Operations with leading organizations 

 

 

SYNOPSIS 

❑ A result oriented professional with about 8 years of experience in Engineering/Enterprise Data 

Management with MRP systems exposure like- SAP, SL, SPM, TAS. 

❑ Currently associated with Joyson Safety Systems in IMT Manesar, Gurugram. 

❑ A Keen implementer with competencies across- 

1. Part master creation 

2. Bill of Materials (BOM) preparation 

3. ECN Implementation 

4. Product/ Process related documentation management 

5. Co-ordination and communication across affected departments. 

 

❑ Review the Engineering Orders issued by the Engineering Groups to verify the accuracy and ensure 

all established global and local procedures prior to releases were adhered. 

❑ Communicate with the Engineers regarding any issues/findings in the Engineering Orders and 

request corrections, follow up and confirm corrections were implemented. 

❑ Electronically release all Engineering documents and verify all system processing and 

electronic distribution is correct, and ensure all electronic and hard copy documents are filed in 

the proper locations.  

❑ Provide system users with support on issues related to use the basic functions and 

troubleshooting of the system modules. 

❑ Provide any requested specification or internal standards to the Engineers, and verify correct 

version is utilized for engineering testing. 

❑ Maintain metrics to measure the Engineering Processes and create monthly reports . 

❑ Coordinate flow of Design change requests between local Engineering groups and between all global 

regions. 

❑ Administrate users access for all work groups and folders in the internal databases, managed by the 

Global Administration group. 

❑ Administrate/coordinate reviews and releases of all Quality Management Systems document  

directly supporting global regions and providing support to regional local Administrators as needed. 

 

 

 

 

 

 



PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE 

➢ Since Feb’ 2014 to Feb’ 2018 with SGS Tekniks Electronic Manufacturing PVT 

LTD. Gurugram, as an SAP End User (Engineering Support Group). 

➢ From March’2018 to April’19 with IQor Global Services India Private Limited as 

an EDM (Enterprise Data Management) Co-ordinator. 

➢ From Feb,2023 to current date, with Joyson Safety Systems as Document 

Control Coordinator. 

 

o Chief responsibilities include (Mar’18 -Apr’19) - 

1. BOM management-Create Part Master for raw materials, create or setup Bill of Materials in company 

defined format/nomenclature in internal software like (SL, SPM), whenever a new project is received. 

2. ECN management- Update and maintain the BOM (in data management software) whenever there is 

an customer or internal change note is received. 

3. Ensuring Coordination across stake holders to implement the change and documentation for trouble 

free implementation. 

4. Coordinate with Cross functional team to discuss on engineering changes. 

5. Create and maintain BOM for repair processes to be able to dis-assemble the defected parts and 

send them for repair. 

6. Document and prepare MIS for the records for ECN (Engineering Change Notes) and new 

projects implemented in system. 

7. Managing the PGAs(Part Group Attribute), Country of origins(COO) of components, 

semi-finished/finished goods through MRP systems. 

8. Maintain HSN Codes used in GST with product class and sub class of raw materials, capital goods and 

other required materials in co-ordination with trade compliance 

9. Responsible for coordination of SECN (Service Engineering Change Note – process change 

request) like Capture/ Purge/ Process etc for all products approved for India. 

10. ECO implementation (Engineering Change Order – BOM update request) for SPB (Spare Part 

BOM) like hard roll or soft roll. 

11. Support SCM(Supply Chain Management) to load their templates into SPM for setting up the 

Price, lead time, vendor setup, MOQ and Lot size update and WQ on request from Buyer. 

12. Support and Co-ordinate with international teams (in Europe and USA, UK) for fixing database 

related issues. 

13. Participate in audit related activities related to EDM process. 

 

o Chief responsibilities include (Feb’14 -Feb’18) 

➢ BOM (Bill of materials) preparation:- 

1. Create item codes for raw materials-Check the database for existing items being used in the 

company and create new item code for raw material which are not existing in the database but 

 required for product manufacturing. 

2. Raise query to customer in case of missing information of components, raw materials, drawings, and 

other specification as per defined nomenclature. 

3. Follow up with customer/concerned product owner for proper closure of raised queries. 

4. Punch/ Prepare the BOM (Bill of materials) in SAP. 

5. Validation of system generated BOM with respect to customer BOM. 



6. Control and release the punched BOM into system. 

 

➢ ECN implementation: - 

1. ECN Handling for new products as well as for existing models running into continuation. 

2. Implementation of ECN in system as per customer requirement due to change in design/ product 

requirement. 

3. Implement the ECN in case of addition of missing information in system. 

4. Any internal change is required for product manufacturing. 

5. Validation of BOM w.r.t ECN. 

6. Intimating and distribution of implementation ECN to Materials team, Production, PPC and other 

relevant teams. 

 

➢ Documentation: - 

1. Maintaining the BOM / ECN data for record retention and easy retrieval of data. 

2. Manage the information received from customer in form of drawings, specifications and other data. 

3. Control of documents, drawings and other QMS related data. 

 

 

EDUCATION 

▪ B.Tech (ECE) from SITM Collage Rewari (2013) 

 

SKILLS AND Competencies: 

▪ End User of SAP, SL-SPM and TAS MRP systems. 

▪ Microsoft Excel, Word, Office and Power Point. 

▪ Strong written and verbal communication skills 

▪ Experienced in the execution of change management. 

▪ Strong organizational and interpersonal skills 

▪ Project management. 

 

PERSONAL VITAE 

Date of Birth           :      21th OCTOBER 1991 

Correspondence Address       :     M/s J.P & Sons, Old Anaz Mandi, Jhajjar 

Permanent Address          :        W. No. 11, Bhatti Gate, (Near Royal Palace   

            Marriage Hall), Jhajjar 

                                            HARYANA (124103) 

Hobbies       :  Reading newspaper                                                

Date & Place:      Signature
